title: Feynman and Wheeler's 1945 paper on time-symmetric electromagnetism

tellings.quote: theory Richard feineman in 1945 wrote a key paper with wheeler

plain: A biologist and writer named Rupert Sheldrake, talking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a 1945 paper by the physicists Richard Feynman and John Wheeler. Sheldrake says it was a key paper on a theory of electromagnetism, the physics of electricity, magnetism and light, in which effects can run both forward and backward in time. He raises it because, if taken seriously, it would leave room for the future influencing the present.
